attorneys: Mr. Walter J. Suthon, Jr., with whom Messrs. J. Blanc Monroe and Monte M. Lemann were on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Messrs. C. V. Parker and Joéeph A. Lovet for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The writ of error is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question on. the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr; 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.

Messrs. C. V. Parker and Joéeph A. Lovet for defendants in error.
